text:
sanjay: Heads-up, AcmeCorp submitted a pilot ask: temporary 2x burst over committed slab + a $30k onboarding credit for 90 days. Need product alignment for sprint planning.
kelly: Can you paste the exact customer wording?
sanjay: "Allow short-term 2x burst above committed slab, plus a 30k free-credit bucket for onboarding, with a softcap that alerts but doesn't block." They want this in a 90d pilot contract.
mike: Hosted API usage or reserved capacity? This changes risk profile.
sanjay: Hosted API. They may request an SLA during the pilot if we enable burst.
anne: Proposed MVP launch criteria: 1) Console softcap + alerting UI, 2) Billing credit bucket applied automatically, 3) Pilot clause in contract, 4) Ops runbook for manual mitigation. Stretch: auto-fallback to lower-cost model variant if sustained.
legal-bot: Draft clause suggestion: "Pilot burst credits are time-limited, non-transferable, and revocable; sustained overage may be billed or throttled." Also ask: do we need dataplane isolation for liability?
finance-sara: Quick estimate: if burst used 20% of the time, incremental cost ~ $12k/mo. Credits impact first-month revenue. Need P&L stub for sign-off and sales comp implications.
eng-max: Implementation notes: console + meter change ~= 2 sprint-days. Auto-fallback requires routing policy + compat checks across model versions, ~3-4 sprint-days + QA.
kelly: Could we ship alerting + credits first and defer auto-fallback? Sales wants to move fast.
mike: Ops risk if we defer fallback; acceptable for pilot only if Sales/CS accept elevated risk.
anne: Trade: MVP = alerting + credit + pilot clause. Gate to GA = zero major incidents and unit cost below threshold.
legal-bot: Add customer obligations: provide burst pattern reporting and consent to rate-limit enforcement.
finance-sara: I'll run a 90d P&L stub and cap credits at $30k as a hard limit.
sanjay: Action items: Anne -> spec MVP vs stretch; Eng-Max -> detailed estimate for fallback; Legal -> draft pilot language; Finance -> P&L stub; Sales -> confirm Acme accepts pilot risk.
anne: I'll post a spec draft EOD tomorrow. Drop any latency or regional constraints here. :thumbsup:
eng-max: Note: model downgrade requires a compatibility matrix; including that in the estimate.
kelly: Thanks all — good framing.
sanjay: I'll loop in Sales Ops and CSMs now. :rocket:
